context_for_next_testing_agent: Both HIGH-priority bugs from iteration_76 are now resolved. If another iteration runs, focus areas: (a) silence Radix DialogContent aria-describedby warnings across dealer dialogs, (b) consolidate the cheque_uploaded/docUploaded logic between DealerProfileMenu and Phase2Banner so they cannot diverge in future. Backend Wave 102 regression file /app/backend/tests/test_wave102_outreach_query.py remains the canonical regression — 6/6 pass.
rca of the issue: Iteration 76's two HIGH bugs both stemmed from /auth/me's supplier payload missing the cheque_uploaded boolean (admin's source of truth for the bank-proof slot). Without it, Phase2Banner's hasAnyGap() returned false for Amman (path was set, banner suppressed) and DealerProfileMenu's missing-docs computation didn't surface the gap either. Iteration 77 fix: _SUPP_COLS in /app/backend/routes/auth.py:553-558 now selects cheque_uploaded (plus contact_person/email/phone/state/pincode/gst_number/pan_number/business_address for the My Details dialog). Phase2Banner.jsx introduced docUploaded(s,key) which treats cheque_uploaded===false as 'missing' regardless of doc_bank_proof path, matching admin Dealers table. The React useEffect for externalOpen auto-close was moved above the early `if (!supplier) return null;` return to honour rules-of-hooks (preventing the 'Cannot update a component while rendering' warning). DealerProfileMenu.MissingDocsDialog now computes its own missing-list and short-circuits to the empty-state dialog when nothing is missing, so Phase2Banner never has to no-op-render inside it.
